customer: I just found out your offer on my SUV is less than what I still owe on the loan, and I'm pretty annoyed. I'm retired and was counting on this sale to clear the loan, not make things worse. Can I even sell it to you now, or is this a dead end?
agent: I understand the frustration, and you can still sell us your SUV even though the loan balance is higher than our offer; this is called negative equity, or being upside down. At your appointment, we'll compare the offer with your payoff letter, and you'd pay the difference then. For that payment we accept a cashier's check, a debit card or a personal check, but we can't accept credit cards. You can find these details in our article "If you owe more than our offer."
